configuration.query: What are the accounts that do not have any opportunities? What are the contacts of those accounts?
configuration.rephrase: The query will list out accounts with their contact names which don't have any opportunities
configuration.standardsql: SELECT [account].*, [contact].[fullName] AS [contactName] FROM [account] JOIN [contact] ON [account].[primaryContactId] = [contact].[contactId] WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT [opportunityid] FROM [opportunity] WHERE [opportunity].[parentaccountid] = [account].[accountId])
